steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: The Sun Crow has been driven to the designated coordinates. The armored units have finished clearing out the scattered Corruptors. The drones are retreating to a safe location. The vanguard troops are ready to move out at any time!

In the desert thirteen kilometers away from the DisSea, the FAC have set up a temporary base and are waiting for the next move. Next to them, the Eastian envoys have formed a circle. The Sinners known as sealers are gathering their power, patterned green light gradually falling into a sorcerous formation.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Are you still clear about our strategy?

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: Sure. The FAC will corner the Sun Crow into the sorcery with firepower, then we will do our best to restrain it, opening up a chance for the seer to perform the Sun Shot.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Good. Just don't get cold feet and mess things up later. The FAC has poured a huge amount of resources into this operation, so your silly myth better be useful. Don't waste our Hypercubes.

steps.speaker: Eastian Envoy
steps.content: Waste? You saw with your own eyes how effective the Eastian sorcery has been for suppressing the Sun Crow. How about you count how many Hypercubes we've saved you and send them back to us in Eastia?

The two sides seem to have grown more irritable with each other in the past few days. You seldom see that officer snap like that, and even the Eastian ambassador has lost his composure. You turn your head and whisper to Du Ruo.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Should we say something?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Heh, let them be. That's the conversation style they've acquired after quarreling through all the meetings. They're just having a friendly exchange now.
Mania intensification will stop completely in a shackled Sinner. Not even contact with contamination will result in corruption.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: How are the things I asked the FAC to do going?

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: You mean the rituals? It's all done. We've set up altars in the busiest places.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: But... will it work? Most passersby simply laugh at it.
According to the method used in Eastia seven years ago, the envoys requested to place the leftover bow materials in different corners of the city, calling it a "ritual of faith".

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Let's give it a try. Consider it a small experiment to verify my guess...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Next, I'll just count on you guys.
You and Yanyan observe the Sun Crow's movements from behind cover.
This is the best vantage point, the optimal location for the Sun Shot calculated by Yanyan with her compass.
In the distance, white armored units form a horizontal line under the huge wings of the dormant Apostle, poised to strike.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Once the FAC open fire and drive the Sun Crow Apostle into the sorcery, that's our chance. We've only got one arrow. You got this, just try to remember how much you've practiced!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Once the FAC open fire and draw the Sun Crow's attention, complete the Sun Shot immediately.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Roger that! Du Ruo has already made me learn everything by heart.
Arrow on string, the young Sun Shooter is ready to draw the bow. On the other end of the shackles, you can feel Yanyan's M-value fluttering.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: You bet! I'm soooooo nervous!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: But for those vanished cities, for my predecessors who sacrificed their lives, and for those who believe in the myth... I must do it no matter how nervous I am!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Breathe in, breathe out... You can do it, Yanyan... Du Ruo said I've worked hard, and I'm not alone. There are many others backing me up!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I must accomplish the mission the Great Seer entrusted to me. Never let the ten suns descend upon the world again!
She gives herself a pep talk, then turns and smiles at you. Under the blinding sun, for an instant, the way Yanyan turns her head back reminds you of the woman in your dreams.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We'll get things ready for you.
Immediately, you hear a distant chant. Patterned green light shines and covers the entire battlefield.
You turn back to find the sealers casting spells in a formation. Among them, Du Ruo signs to you: Good luck.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Sun Crow image confirmed. Operation begins. FAC, fire!
At the command, the FAC armored vehicles fire together, meeting the fiery bird head-on.
